title: 离骚
author: 屈原
intro: Five famous couplets from China’s longest ancient poem, by Qu Yuan — the loyal minister whose death is remembered every year at the Dragon Boat Festival. “The road ahead is long and far; I will search high and low” is still quoted by anyone who refuses to give up.
analysis: 《离骚》是屈原的代表作，也是中国古代最长的抒情诗。“离骚”大意是“遭遇忧愁”。屈原一心想让楚国强大，却被小人陷害、被国君疏远，这首长诗写的就是他的痛苦和坚持。这里选了五组名句：第一组说自己怕年华老去、来不及建立美好的名声，所以早上喝木兰花上的露水，晚上吃菊花的花瓣——这是用香草比喻自己品德高洁，叫“香草美人”的手法。第二组写他为百姓生活艰难而流泪，并说只要是心中认为对的，就算死九次也不后悔。最后一句“路漫漫其修远兮，吾将上下而求索”，说前面的路又长又远，我要上上下下不停地寻找，今天仍常被用来鼓励人坚持追求。句中的“兮”相当于“啊”，是楚辞最明显的标志。
analysisEn: “Encountering Sorrow” is Qu Yuan’s greatest work and the longest lyric poem of ancient China. Qu Yuan wanted to make his state of Chu strong, but jealous rivals slandered him and the king pushed him away. The poem pours out his pain — and his refusal to bend. Here are five of its best-known couplets. In the first, he fears growing old before he has made a good name, so he drinks dew from magnolias in the morning and eats fallen chrysanthemum petals at night. He is not describing a real diet: fragrant plants stand for a pure, noble character, a technique later called “fragrant plants and fair ladies” (香草美人). In the second group he weeps over how hard the people’s lives are, and declares that for what his heart believes is right, he would die nine times without regret. The last line — “The road ahead is long and far; I will search high and low” — is still quoted to encourage anyone pursuing a hard goal. Notice the character 兮 (xī) in every line: a sigh-like particle, a bit like “oh”, and the clearest mark of the Chu style of poetry, the Chuci.
background: Qu Yuan (c. 340–278 BC) was a nobleman and minister of the state of Chu during the Warring States period. Slandered and sent into exile, he is said to have drowned himself in the Miluo River when Chu’s capital fell to Qin. Tradition says people raced boats to find him and threw rice into the river to keep fish away from his body — the legendary origin of dragon boat races and zongzi at the Dragon Boat Festival (the fifth day of the fifth lunar month).
pronunciation: 兮 xī（语气词，相当于“啊”）；朝饮的“朝”读 zhāo（早晨，不读 cháo）；长太息的“长”读 cháng；涕 tì（古义眼泪，不是鼻涕）；冉冉 rǎn rǎn；余 yú（我）；落英的“英”读 yīng（花瓣）。
version: 采用通行的王逸《楚辞章句》系统文本。《离骚》全诗约 373 句、近 2500 字。这里选了三处名句：第 1 段（老冉冉……夕餐秋菊之落英）出自前半部分，两句相连；第 2 段两句出自其后不远（统编教材高中节选部分），两句之间略去“余虽好修姱以鞿羁兮……又申之以揽茝”两句；第 3 段出自中段，诗人上天求索之前。“路漫漫”王逸本作“路曼曼”，今通行写作“漫漫”。“落英”有“落下的花瓣”和“初开的花”两种解释，此处取前者。

lines.zh: 老冉冉其将至兮，恐修名之不立。
lines.rhythm: 老冉冉/其将至兮，恐修名/之不立
lines.py: lǎo rǎn rǎn qí jiāng zhì xī, kǒng xiū míng zhī bù lì
lines.lit: Old age is slowly approaching; I fear a fine name will not be established.
lines.en: Old age creeps closer day by day; I fear I’ll grow old before my good name is made.

lines.zh: 朝饮木兰之坠露兮，夕餐秋菊之落英。
lines.rhythm: 朝饮/木兰之/坠露兮，夕餐/秋菊之/落英
lines.py: zhāo yǐn mù lán zhī zhuì lù xī, xī cān qiū jú zhī luò yīng
lines.lit: In the morning I drink the dew dripping from magnolias; in the evening I eat the fallen petals of autumn chrysanthemums.
lines.en: At dawn I drink dew dripping from the magnolia; at dusk I dine on fallen chrysanthemum petals.
lines.tts: 招饮木兰之坠露兮，夕餐秋菊之落英。

lines.zh: 长太息以掩涕兮，哀民生之多艰。
lines.rhythm: 长太息/以掩涕兮，哀民生/之多艰
lines.py: cháng tài xī yǐ yǎn tì xī, āi mín shēng zhī duō jiān
lines.lit: With a long, deep sigh I wipe away my tears, grieving that the people’s lives are so hard.
lines.en: I heave a long sigh and wipe my tears — how hard the people’s lives are!
lines.tts: 常太息以掩涕兮，哀民生之多艰。

lines.zh: 亦余心之所善兮，虽九死其犹未悔。
lines.rhythm: 亦余心/之所善兮，虽九死/其犹未悔
lines.py: yì yú xīn zhī suǒ shàn xī, suī jiǔ sǐ qí yóu wèi huǐ
lines.lit: Since this is what my heart holds good, though I die nine times I would still not regret it.
lines.en: This is what my heart knows to be right — I could die nine times and never regret it.

lines.zh: 路漫漫其修远兮，吾将上下而求索。
lines.rhythm: 路漫漫/其修远兮，吾将/上下/而求索
lines.py: lù màn màn qí xiū yuǎn xī, wú jiāng shàng xià ér qiú suǒ
lines.lit: The road is long, so long and far; I will go up and down, searching.
lines.en: The road ahead is long and far — I will search for the truth, high and low.

words.note: 楚辞的标志性语气词，今天不用，只在仿古诗文里见到。
现代汉语“冉冉升起”（慢慢升起）。
现代汉语“朝气”“朝阳”，读 zhāo。
一种开香花的树。也是“花木兰”的名字。
英：花。陶渊明“落英缤纷”里也有这个词。
涕：古义眼泪，今天“涕”多指鼻涕，如“痛哭流涕”里还保留古义。
今天常说“民生问题”；也有人解释为“人生”。
古汉语第一人称，今天说“我”。
九表示多次。今天成语“九死一生”。
现代汉语说“仍然”“还”，“记忆犹新”里还保留。
修：长。今天“修长”还保留这个意思。
现代汉语书面语“探索”“求索精神”。

imagery.name: 菊
imagery.zh: 吃秋菊的花瓣，比喻保持自己高洁的品德，不和坏人同流合污。
imagery.en: Eating chrysanthemum petals is a way of saying he keeps his character pure and refuses to join the corrupt.

imagery.name: 兰
imagery.zh: 喝木兰上的露水，和秋菊一样，是用香草写自己的美好品格。
imagery.en: Drinking dew from the magnolia, like eating chrysanthemums, uses fragrant plants to describe his noble nature.

imagery.name: 路
imagery.zh: 漫长遥远的路，象征追求真理和理想的艰难过程。
imagery.en: The long, far road stands for the hard, lifelong search for truth and for his ideals.
